values.en: The partial value forms of the two one-sided limits. They are the basis for the one-sided derivatives, and comparing the two values is how the classification of discontinuities is stated.
values.zh-CN: 两个单侧极限的偏值形式。它们是单侧导数的基础，而比较这两个值则是表述间断点分类的方式。
